The median value was used, here and in subsequent tables in this section, as the target since there were no measured values. EPIcode results were not incorporated into the median value in all comparisons for the Macdona, Texas and Festus, Missouri scenarios. Therefore, the median represent the value only among the set of models in Hanna (2008). EPIcode results are within a factor range of 2.2–3.3 from the median up to 0.5 km from the source and improve significantly beyond that distance to a range of 1.1–1.3.
